soru: Çok kipli büyük dil modelleriyle çalışan çoklu robot ağlarında algılama, haberleşme ve hesaplamanın birlikte ele alınması üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Çok kipli büyük dil modelleriyle çalışan çoklu robot ağlarında algılama, haberleşme ve hesaplamanın birlikte ele alınması üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2026-02-28. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first), each with its arXiv id and/or DOI. You may search the web.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models for Multi-Robot Systems: A Survey
calismalar.gerekce: This is the most complete survey of how LLMs and multimodal LLMs are used in multi-robot systems for communication, task allocation, planning and control, and it lists the open problems.

calismalar.baslik: Integrated Sensing-Communication-Computation for Edge Artificial Intelligence
calismalar.gerekce: It sets out the integrated sensing-communication-computation (ISCC) framework for edge AI, the core framework for handling sensing, communication and computation together.

calismalar.baslik: Task-Oriented Integrated Sensing, Computation and Communication for Wireless Edge AI
calismalar.gerekce: It brings in task-oriented ISCC design and shows how to allocate resources across sensing, computation and communication against inference accuracy.

calismalar.baslik: Integrated Sensing and Communications: Toward Dual-Functional Wireless Networks for 6G and Beyond
calismalar.gerekce: It is the reference ISAC survey that set up the theoretical and practical basis for integrated sensing and communication.

calismalar.baslik: Pushing Large Language Models to the 6G Edge: Vision, Challenges, and Opportunities
calismalar.gerekce: It defines the vision and challenges of running LLMs at the 6G edge through split, collaborative and on-device inference.

calismalar.baslik: Mobile Edge Intelligence for Large Language Models: A Contemporary Survey
calismalar.gerekce: It surveys edge caching, distributed training and inference of LLMs, the main source on the computation-communication side.

calismalar.baslik: RoCo: Dialectic Multi-Robot Collaboration with Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: It is a landmark work in which LLM-based robot agents coordinate collaboration by communicating in natural language.

calismalar.baslik: Scalable Multi-Robot Collaboration with Large Language Models: Centralized or Decentralized Systems?
calismalar.gerekce: It compares centralized and decentralized LLM-based multi-robot architectures in terms of communication cost and scalability.

calismalar.baslik: SMART-LLM: Smart Multi-Agent Robot Task Planning using Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: It shows a framework for LLM-based multi-robot task decomposition, coalition formation and allocation.

calismalar.baslik: Building Cooperative Embodied Agents Modularly with Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: CoELA builds embodied agents that perceive, communicate and plan with LLMs under communication cost, a key work.

calismalar.baslik: PaLM-E: An Embodied Multimodal Language Model
calismalar.gerekce: It is the pioneering embodied multimodal LLM that combines sensor data with language for robot reasoning.

calismalar.baslik: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
calismalar.gerekce: It laid the foundation for vision-language-action models that turn multimodal perception straight into robot actions.

calismalar.baslik: Where2comm: Communication-Efficient Collaborative Perception via Spatial Confidence Maps
calismalar.gerekce: It is a key work that optimizes the perception-communication trade-off in multi-agent collaborative perception.

calismalar.baslik: V2VNet: Vehicle-to-Vehicle Communication for Joint Perception and Prediction
calismalar.gerekce: It pioneered communication-based collaborative perception by sharing intermediate features between agents.

calismalar.baslik: When2com: Multi-Agent Perception via Communication Graph Grouping
calismalar.gerekce: It brought in learned communication-graph construction for bandwidth-efficient multi-agent perception.

calismalar.baslik: Who2com: Collaborative Perception via Learnable Handshake Communication
calismalar.gerekce: It was the first to address learning whom to communicate with in collaborative perception between robots.

calismalar.baslik: Task-Oriented Communications for 6G: Vision, Principles, and Technologies
calismalar.gerekce: It gives the principles of task-oriented communication, which underlies sending only task-relevant information to multi-robot networks.

calismalar.baslik: Large AI Model Empowered Multimodal Semantic Communications
calismalar.gerekce: It shows how large multimodal models can be used for semantic communication.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model-Driven Distributed Integrated Multimodal Sensing and Semantic Communications
calismalar.gerekce: LLM-DiSAC brings together distributed multimodal sensing and semantic communication under an LLM.

calismalar.baslik: Multi-Agent Embodied AI: Advances and Future Directions
calismalar.gerekce: It surveys multi-agent embodied AI systems and their open problems in a systematic way.

calismalar.baslik: Toward Edge General Intelligence with Agentic AI and Agentification: Concepts, Technologies, and Future Directions
calismalar.gerekce: It surveys the distributed edge setting in which agentic LLM agents work together.

calismalar.baslik: Aligning Cyber Space with Physical World: A Comprehensive Survey on Embodied AI
calismalar.gerekce: It is a broad survey that covers embodied perception, interaction and multimodal models together.

calismalar.baslik: Edge-Device Large Language Model Inference: Split Inference and Collaborative Edge-Cloud Computing
calismalar.gerekce: It represents the edge-cloud split-inference line of work that underlies offloading robot MLLM inference.

calismalar.baslik: LLMind: Orchestrating AI and IoT with LLM for Complex Task Execution
calismalar.gerekce: It shows an LLM orchestrating distributed IoT/sensor devices to carry out tasks.

calismalar.baslik: Large Multi-Modal Models (LMMs) as Universal Foundation Models for AI-Native Wireless Systems
calismalar.gerekce: It sets out the vision of multimodal foundation models as the core of AI-native wireless networks.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models for Networking: Applications, Enabling Techniques, and Challenges
calismalar.gerekce: It surveys how LLMs are used in network management and communication optimization.

calismalar.baslik: Over-the-Air Computation for 6G: Foundations, Technologies, and Applications
calismalar.gerekce: It surveys over-the-air computation (AirComp), a key technique for merging communication and computation in distributed sensing.

calismalar.baslik: Collaborative Perception in Autonomous Driving: Methods, Datasets and Challenges
calismalar.gerekce: It systematizes the methods, datasets and communication-related open problems of collaborative perception.

calismalar.baslik: Edge Large AI Models: Revolutionizing 6G Networks
calismalar.gerekce: It discusses the architecture and resource-management challenges of deploying large AI models at the 6G edge.

calismalar.baslik: Task-Oriented Autonomous Communications with Large Language Models and Large Multimodal Models
calismalar.gerekce: It surveys LLM/LMM-based task-oriented autonomous communications and includes an LLM-based robot scheduling case study.
